# Large Language Models (LLMs) MOC

A central index for exploring concepts, architectures, and strategies related to **[LLM](./)**.

## Core Concepts
- **[Tokenization](../tokenization/)**: Character, word, and sub-word (BPE) techniques.
- **[Encoder](../encoder/)** / **[decoder](../decoder/)**: Feature extraction (bidirectional) vs autoregressive generation (causal).
- **Needle-in-a-Haystack**: Benchmarking long-context retrieval and biases.

## Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- **[RAG Overview](../rag/)**: Modalities (Text, Hybrid, Full Multimodal).
- **RAG Strategies MOC**: (Candidate MOC)
  - **[Re-ranking](../re-ranking/)**: Two-stage retrieval for precision.
  - **[Agentic RAG](../agentic-rag/)**: Autonomous tool selection.
  - **[Knowledge Graphs](../knowledge-graphs/) (GraphRAG)**: Relational retrieval.
    - **[Microsoft GraphRAG](../microsoft-graphrag/)**
    - **[LightRAG](../lightrag/)**

## Performance & Optimization
- **Quantization**: Model compression (GPTQ, AWQ, 1.58-bit).
  - **[TurboQuant](../turboquant/)**: Fast quantized kernels.
- **[Token Caching](../token-caching/)**: Reusing [KV caches](../token-caching/) for speed.
- **[Speculative Decoding](../speculative-decoding/)**: Draft model generation with target validation.
- **Serving Engines**:
  - **[vLLM](../vllm/)**: High-throughput serving with PagedAttention.
  - **[LMCache](../lmcache/)**: Shared cache infrastructure.

## Multimodal Models
- **MLLM**: Multimodal LLMs capable of processing images, audio, and video.
- **HYMMRag**: Hybrid Multimodal RAG.
- **FMMRag**: Full Multimodal RAG.
